map.兽药休药期倒计时器 使用指南: Veterinary Drug Withdrawal Period Countdown — User Guide
map.选择所用兽药并输入末次用药日期，按该药法定休药期计算可安全屠宰或挤奶的日期，确保: Select the drug used and enter the last dose date; compute the safe slaughter or milking date per the drug's legal withdrawal period to keep animal products food-safe.
map.由末次用药日与休药期推算可售日期。: Derive the sellable date from last dose and withdrawal period.
map.按药物（青霉素/四环素等）标准休药。: Follow standard withdrawal by drug (penicillin/tetracycline, etc.).
map.规避药残超标出栏。: Avoid slaughter with drug residues over the limit.
map.：当前距可售剩 N 天，未到不得出栏屠宰。: : N days remain until sellable; do not slaughter before then.
map.未过休药期出栏致肉中药残超标，违规且危害安全。: Slaughtering before withdrawal ends leaves drug residues—non-compliant and unsafe.
map.按药物代谢与动物种而定，青霉素猪约 28 天、禽更短。: Depends on drug metabolism and species; pig penicillin ≈28 days, poultry shorter.
